loss: 0.75 simple RNNT + 0.55 pruned RNNT + 0.2 CTC; prune_range=5, am_scale=0, lm_scale=0.25; sum reduction
gradient_clipping: global norm 5.0; stop on any nonfinite loss or gradient
frontend: 16 kHz mono normalized float waveform; kaldifeat 80-bin fbank, zero dither, snip_edges=false, high_freq=-400
training_targets: exact P34 training_text and stored full-string token IDs; no changes
decoding: P19 Sherpa-ONNX CPU greedy 4 threads; no external LM
selection: lowest corpus WER on 282 P34 dev WAVs after NFC, casefold, whitespace collapse and punctuation removal; tie -> earlier epoch; CER diagnostic; baseline and candidate identical normalization
early_stopping: none; 2 epochs unless numerical or correctness failure
decision: GO only delta >= +5 absolute F1 points, paired bootstrap 95% CI > 0 and no unacceptable execution regressions; positive statistically inconclusive INCONCLUSIVE, otherwise NO-GO
